name: game-crash-recovery
title: Game Crash Recovery
intent: Play surface folds into an inset crash dialog with retry and close.
acceptance: Crashed phase folds play surface with rotateX 62deg over 280ms
Error panel reaches opacity 1 over 360ms with RETRY and CLOSE APP
RETRY or CLOSE APP restores playing phase

reducedMotion.behaviour: End states remain; fold and panel transitions removed
